integrity: Exact independent exhaustive verifiers of the finite enumeration and natural automorphism classification are included; their decoded source and exact census were replayed together.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the 24-vertex three-stage cyclic undirected binary butterfly, not ordinary layered butterfly networks or other dimensions.
The finite exhaustive proof and complete list of optima are reproducible, but have not undergone independent external audit.

Foucaud thesis is dated June 2009 without a verified first public release day; 2009-08-19 is the independently verified public preprint date of a separate cited identifying-code antecedent, not an asserted thesis posting date.
Unindexed previously existing small-graph classifications may be undiscovered.
title: One symmetry class of optimal identifying codes on the three-stage cyclic butterfly
